title: KHR_node_camera_hint glTF Node Extension
description: Associates a node with a passive, advisory camera descriptor. For every role, the initial camera pose is interpreted from the node's global transform using the core glTF camera view-matrix rules. If those rules leave the view matrix undefined, no initial camera pose is defined; the host may ignore it or derive a pose through host-defined adaptation. An optional targetNode supplies the subject point without changing that pose.

role.description: Nonempty semantic role for this camera hint. The exact, case-sensitive standard values are 'default_view', 'detail', 'first_person', 'framing_view', 'full_body', 'orbit_view', 'portrait', and 'third_person'; any other value is a custom role. Every role, standard or custom, describes a candidate initial camera pose. Roles classify authored intent and never select or activate a camera; the specification recommends a deterministic choice among default_view hints for hosts that automatically choose a default view from camera hints without restricting the candidates to other roles, and recommends that hosts not use or surface hints with unrecognized custom roles in default camera affordances.

camera.description: Advisory index of a glTF camera whose projection definition is associated with this hint. The reference does not instantiate the camera or override node.camera. When undefined, the hint carries no projection data; a node.camera on the hint node does not supply it.
camera.gltf_detailedDescription: This value MUST be a valid index into the top-level `cameras` array. Extensions on the referenced camera retain their own support contracts.

targetNode.description: Index of a different glTF node whose global translation is the hint's subject point: the point of interest, framing subject, or orbit center. It does not change the initial camera pose or define any orientation. When undefined or not usable (an invalid index or a reference to the hint node itself), the hint defines no subject point and a host may choose one.
targetNode.gltf_detailedDescription: This value MUST be a valid index into the top-level `nodes` array and MUST NOT refer to the node containing this extension.

label.description: Nonempty human-readable label for the viewpoint, preferred over node.name whenever a host or tool presents the hint to a user. It has no camera behavior and no defined localization mechanism.
